title: Grade 2 Math — Tue, May 26
description: 2D Shapes — Day 2 of 5: Sides, corners, and comparing shapes
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Which shape has MORE sides — a triangle or a square?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 sides. A triangle has 3 sides. 4 > 3, so a square has more sides.

questions.question: How many corners does a rectangle have?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has 4 corners — one at each angle. Same as a square!

questions.question: A triangle has 3 sides. How many corners does it have?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 corners — same as the number of sides. Every polygon has the same number of sides and corners.

questions.question: Which shape has MORE corners — a pentagon or a triangle?
questions.explanation: A pentagon has 5 corners. A triangle has 3 corners. 5 > 3, so a pentagon has more corners.

questions.question: Count the corners: square + triangle = ?
questions.explanation: Square has 4 corners + Triangle has 3 corners = 7 corners total.

questions.question: Which has FEWER sides — a hexagon or a square?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 sides, a hexagon has 6 sides. 4 < 6, so a square has fewer sides.

questions.question: A square and a rectangle both have ___ sides.
questions.explanation: Both a square and a rectangle have 4 sides. The difference is a square has all equal sides, a rectangle does not.

questions.question: What is the difference between a square and a rectangle?
options: Square has all equal sides; rectangle has 2 long and 2 short sides
questions.explanation: Both have 4 sides, but a square's 4 sides are ALL equal. A rectangle has 2 long sides and 2 short sides.

questions.question: How many sides does a pentagon have?
questions.explanation: A pentagon has 5 sides. Penta = five. It also has 5 corners.

questions.question: Total sides: triangle + rectangle = ?
questions.explanation: Triangle has 3 sides + Rectangle has 4 sides = 7 sides total.

questions.question: Which shape is round?
questions.explanation: A circle is round — it has no sides or corners.

questions.question: A hexagon has 6 sides. How many corners does it have?
questions.explanation: A hexagon has 6 corners — same as its 6 sides. Every shape has the same number of sides and corners.

questions.question: Which shape has the MOST sides: triangle, square, or pentagon?
questions.explanation: Triangle = 3, Square = 4, Pentagon = 5. Pentagon has the most sides.

questions.question: How many sides does an octagon have?
questions.explanation: An octagon has 8 sides. Octo = eight, like an octopus with 8 legs!

questions.question: Total corners: square + hexagon = ?
questions.explanation: Square has 4 corners + Hexagon has 6 corners = 10 corners total.
